dialogues.speaker: Davy
dialogues.text: While I was wandering around looking for inspiration, I noticed something shiny out of the corner of my eye. To me, it looked like Crystal Ore...

dialogues.speaker: Davy
dialogues.text: But a rare type — at least, I haven't seen any of that quality before. The rough location was...

dialogues.speaker: Davy
dialogues.text: ...There. I've marked it on your map. Perhaps you might have some use for it?
